QF.id: IV Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_2

question.text: According to the SEBI code of conduct, a stock broker must NOT refuse to deal with a small investor merely on the ground of:

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI code of conduct requires a stock broker to execute orders faithfully at the best available market price and prohibits refusal to deal with a small investor merely on the ground of the volume of business involved. The Trap: Refusing service because of incomplete KYC documentation or genuine non-payment of previous dues can be legitimate, and a credit score is not the test under the SEBI code. The specific prohibition is against refusing on the ground of small business volume alone.
